subject: explained variance in selective genotyping design and non-normal phenotype distribution

messages.author: a2e8310c8ee85c7c
messages.subject: explained variance in selective genotyping design and non-normal phenotype distribution
parts:
Hi all, 

I have performed an inter-cross and the distribution of phenotypes in the F2 is bimodal. There is a clear dominance effect (F1 share a phenotype with one of either P0). I selectively genotyped the F2 individuals and used the "qtlMprob" package to identified the QTL. Now I need to assess the explained phenotypic variance for each QTL, and wonder if anyone has an input on how to approach this problem. 

Thank you very much for your help.

Best regards,
Dario

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] explained variance in selective genotyping design and non-normal phenotype distribution
parts:
I think this problem is extremely hard and may be impossible, given the structure of the data, with the selective genotyping.

karl
